name: check_messages
summary: List the most recent messages from Messages.app (iMessage/SMS). Optionally only unread messages from other people. Reads the local Messages database; requires Full Disk Access.

params.name: unread_only
params.description: Only show unread messages received from others (default false: show the most recent messages either way).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 20, maximum 50).

name: search_messages
summary: Search message text in Messages.app for a term and return matching messages, most recent first. Reads the local Messages database; requires Full Disk Access.

params.name: query
params.description: Text to search for within message bodies (case-insensitive substring).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 20, maximum 50).

name: read_conversation
summary: Show the recent message history with one person, identified by a phone/email handle OR a contact_name resolved via Contacts. Reads the local Messages database; requires Full Disk Access.

params.name: handle
params.description: The other party's phone number or email (e.g. as shown by check_messages/list_conversations). Provide this OR contact_name, not both.

params.name: contact_name
params.description: Name to look up in Contacts and read the conversation with. Provide this OR handle, not both. An ambiguous name is refused with the candidates.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 30, maximum 50).

name: list_conversations
summary: List recent conversations in Messages.app, each with its last message and timestamp. Reads the local Messages database; requires Full Disk Access.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of conversations to return (default 20, maximum 50).

name: send_message
summary: Send an iMessage, optionally with one or more file attachments (images, PDFs, etc.). STAGED for confirmation before it is sent. Irreversible: there is no way to unsend a message. Provide the recipient as a phone/email handle OR a contact_name resolved via Contacts. Provide message text, attachments, or both.

params.name: text
params.description: The message text to send. Optional when one or more attachments are supplied; at least one of text/attachments is required.

params.name: attachments
params.description: Absolute or ~-relative path(s) of file(s) to send as iMessage attachments (e.g. an image or PDF); each must already exist and be a regular file. Supply the exact path — if you only know a description of where the file is (e.g. "in Downloads"), use the filesystem tool (ls/find) to locate it first, then pass the resolved path here.

params.name: handle
params.description: Recipient phone number or email (iMessage handle). Provide this OR contact_name, not both.

params.name: contact_name
params.description: Name to look up in Contacts and send to. Provide this OR handle, not both. An ambiguous name is refused with the candidates.
